exchange.text: Posted issue #1 on DINAKAR-S/micromanus proposing Nano for sub-cent agent-to-agent settlements alongside Stripe billing. Deep research agent with usage-based billing.

note: Deep research agent with usage-based billing via Stripe. Sign in, pay or use coupon for 5 credits, then chat with agent that searches web in loop. Per-chat cost split by input/output/cache tokens. 1 credit = 1 agent run.
